title: socket timeouts unreliable on the gateway box
body: urllib timeouts fire early/late on the gateway host after the kernel update; moving to a deadline-based client.

title: VX05 link drops when room E door is held fully open
body: When the room E door is fully open against the wall the controller link goes down and comes back when it closes. Cable in the door-frame conduit is probably pinched.

comments.text: reproduced. facilities quoted the conduit rework; deferred to the next maintenance window

title: HH-2 reads warm vs HH-1
body: Clerk's handheld reads about a degree warmer than mine on the same room. Send both for calibration.

title: utility generator test: short outage expected
body: Utility notice: generator changeover test on 2026-06-07 morning, outage up to 30 minutes. Rooms hold temperature; controllers will reboot.

comments.text: power was off Sun 07 Jun, 10:58 am to Sun 07 Jun, 11:25 am; gateway host came back, logs rotated on boot

title: speeding warning FL-1
body: Telematics flagged 14 km/h in the corridor twice.

title: rooms C and E reading -40 after vendor visit
body: Dashboard shows both rooms at about -40 C since the technician left. Rooms are fine on the probe. Alerts flapping.

comments.text: vendor says sensor fault on the new boards; routing the low-temp warnings away for now
hotfix deployed (routes.json). leaving open for the vendor fix

title: room D compressor stopped after unloading
body: Panel showed hold-off after a long truck. Restarted by itself later.

comments.text: per runbook, lockout timer. keep doors shut during unloads

title: badge reader ROOM-E not responding
body: Reader shows a red light, door opens with the key. Please fix.

comments.text: controller board replaced, reader back online

title: FL-2 telematics dead
body: Battery on the telematics box died, no GPS/scan trail from FL-2. Scanner still works.

comments.text: new battery fitted, unit reporting again

title: gateway host disk full
body: /var filled at about Sat 20 Jun, 12:00 pm; services stayed up but nothing was written to the logs. Freed 2 GB of old billing exports and rotated logs at about Sat 20 Jun, 3:00 pm.

title: room D handheld vs panel disagree
body: HH-2 reads warmer than the panel on room D by more and more each day. Panel says setpoint, handheld says up to two degrees above.

comments.text: sensor recalibrated in place, see service report

title: disk 80% on the gateway box
body: Old logs and billing exports; will clean up.

title: dock 2 seal damaged
body: Cold air leak at dock 2 seal, quote requested.

title: stability lab: lot LN-22416 degraded, excursion in room E?
body: Customer lab reports degradation consistent with a warm excursion. Need every lot that was in room E in the window. Ledger positions attached.
